Metadata.title: NoCoda | Product engineering, data and AI
Metadata.description: We join your team to understand the business, build digital products, connect your systems and run the infrastructure they depend on.

Hero.title: An engineering team inside your business.
Hero.subtitle: We design software and AI with the people who know your business. We build the infrastructure behind it and stay to run it with your team.
Hero.cta: Talk to us about your project

Problem.label: Where AI earns its place
Problem.title: Start with the business move.
Problem.titleAccent: Build only what makes it possible.
Problem.intro: The model is rarely the hard part. The hard part is giving it a real decision, usable evidence and a place inside the operation.

points.title: Commercial focus
points.description: Turn scattered market, CRM and conversation signals into prioritized accounts, offers and next actions.

points.title: Operating visibility
points.description: Reconstruct how work actually moves across systems, identify friction and redesign the process around evidence.

points.title: Finance intelligence
points.description: Bring cash, forecast, risk and performance into a shared decision model leaders can interrogate and trust.

points.title: AI-native products
points.description: Turn expert knowledge and operational workflows into useful software for customers and internal teams.

Services.title: What we build
Services.intro: We build the software your team relies on, the products your customers use and the infrastructure that connects them.

operations.title: Internal tools
operations.description: We build shared tools for work that crosses teams, so each person can see what they own and what happens next.

examples.work: A clinic tracks patient referrals and reconciles payments for therapy sessions.
An event producer prepares quotes and its technicians identify equipment by scanning QR codes.

products.title: Digital products
products.description: We design and build storefronts, portals and applications that customers can use on their own.

examples.work: Law firms allocate training hours to lawyers and collect their certificates in one portal.
Shoppers can find a part that fits their car and see the final price in pesos.

ai.title: Applied AI
ai.description: We build assistants that search your documents and agents that carry out tasks. Your team decides which steps need human review.

examples.work: Agents guide merchants through onboarding so they can offer financing at checkout.
A system turns family photos and a written memory into a narrated film.

infrastructure.title: Data infrastructure
infrastructure.description: We connect systems through APIs and data connectors, set up access controls and monitor incoming data.

examples.work: We linked a talent consultancy’s CRM, operations platform and internal documentation.
We matched customs records with business contacts so sales can find the importers of a given product.

DataCenters.title: Data center feasibility and construction
DataCenters.description: We assess the feasibility of your next data center and coordinate design, construction and commissioning with specialists.
DataCenters.workIntro: Before defining the build, we compare what the operation needs with what the site can support.
DataCenters.siteDetail: We review the available space, electrical capacity and room for future expansion.
DataCenters.systemsDetail: With the specialists, we assess how network links will reach the site and how the facility will remove heat from the equipment.
DataCenters.deliveryDetail: We sequence the work, coordinate the specialists involved and support the facility through commissioning.
DataCenters.output: A phased plan and a preliminary budget.
DataCenters.imageAlt: A server aisle lined with equipment racks and orange fiber cables.

seeds.what: Seeds connects companies with independent professionals across Latin America and the United States.
seeds.did: We connected its CRM, an operations dashboard and an assistant that searches internal knowledge. The team can look up information and automate follow-up tasks using its own data.

martis.what: Marti’s ships auto parts from Miami directly to customers in Argentina.
martis.did: We built a storefront that matches 2,958 parts against more than 21,000 vehicle compatibility records. Buyers find the right part and see the final price in pesos. Staff manage the catalog, pricing and orders in the same system.
martis.subject: Auto parts catalog

areafit.what: AreaFit runs a network of gyms in Spain.
areafit.did: We built the dashboard for Fiti, its WhatsApp and Instagram assistant. The team can read conversations by location, identify common questions and see how customers rate the support they receive.
areafit.subject: Gym customer support

psima.what: Psi Mammoliti provides online therapy to Spanish-speaking patients worldwide.
psima.did: We built and operate the system that connects patients, therapists, payments and reconciliation. It also brings together WhatsApp follow-ups and the metrics the team uses every day.

elliecare.what: Ellie Care develops technology for older adults and their families.
elliecare.did: We built a system that turns family photographs and a written memory into a narrated film. AI writes the story, generates the voiceover, animates the images and delivers the video.
elliecare.subject: Family films

ulc.what: ULC works with importers and exporters in Argentina.
ulc.did: We built a CRM that finds companies by the goods they import or export. It uses customs records to identify prospects, adds contact details and ranks leads against the sales team’s target profile.
ulc.subject: Trade prospecting

muecas.what: Muecas produces and distributes snack bars, chocolates and alfajores.
muecas.did: We built an assistant that answers questions using the company’s own documents, automated internal tasks and trained the team to maintain those workflows.
muecas.subject: Internal assistant

HowWeWork.label: Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE)
HowWeWork.title: The people who listen
HowWeWork.intro: We work inside the operation. The same engineers who spend time with your team design the first version, take it into production and come back to see how it holds up.
HowWeWork.photoAlt: Pablo Loyúdice at the NoCoda studio.

steps.title: Follow a real case.
steps.description: We ask to see the last order, complaint or month-end close. The person who handled it walks us through each step, including the spreadsheet only their team knows about.

steps.title: Design with the people using it.
steps.description: We map how information travels, pinpoint the bottleneck and agree on what should change. The people who showed us the problem try the first version.

steps.title: Build the infrastructure.
steps.description: We connect existing tools, organise the data and define access. Applications, AI models and integrations share a foundation the team can operate.

steps.title: Stay involved in production.
steps.description: We work through the first weeks of use, monitor errors and adjust as new cases come in. The team learns to run the system and knows whom to call when things change.

Snowflake.label: Platform capability / Snowflake
Snowflake.title: The platform is a multiplier.
Snowflake.titleAccent: The operating model creates the value.
Snowflake.intro: When Snowflake is the right platform, NoCoda designs the layer that turns governed data into decisions, products and AI workloads people can actually operate.
Snowflake.cardDescription: We connect the warehouse to the decision: the business logic, controls, products and operating routines required to make the investment perform.
capabilities: Decision and workload architecture before warehouse spend
Governed pipelines, semantic models and traceable metrics
Cost, ownership and human controls designed from day one
One accountable line from execution blueprint to production

WhyNoCoda.title: Three ways to start.
WhyNoCoda.intro: We can help you choose where to invest, design a workflow with your team or put a custom system into production.
WhyNoCoda.programBody: During BEFORE AI, leaders spend a day and a half working through their own operations. They leave with priorities, named owners and a plan for the next 90 days.
WhyNoCoda.dataBody: In two to four weeks, we trace how data moves and design the integration. When the workflow calls for it, we use Snowflake to bring sources together and define who can access them.
WhyNoCoda.buildBody: We build, test and operate the system with your team. See one of our own at work in NoCoda.TV, where an editorial workflow turns a news item into an illustrated story.
